plan.acceptance_cases: AT-21 source requirements are not counted as completed by this local test suite.

scope.target: Private Node snapshot bridge, Python decoding/catalog import, and explicit operator CLI.

case_groups.purpose: Use the pinned B01 vector as a fixed cross-language oracle and verify exact persisted raw bytes and Node-derived version keys.
case_groups.method: Real Node child plus immutable B01 seed; fixed snapshot/workflow/profile/bundle hashes, escaped lone-surrogate labels and astral UTF-8 bytes; PostgreSQL BYTEA/text readback.
case_groups.pass_criteria: Golden identifiers and SHA-256 values match literal test constants; returned and stored bytes equal published bytes; labels preserve lone surrogate via JSON escape; no eligibility is created.
case_groups.expected_result: Exact B01 data crosses Node/Python/PostgreSQL without Python recanonicalization or data loss.
case_groups.failure_recovery: Preserve failed attempt and private lifecycle record; fix only the identified boundary/harness defect, rerun the owned targeted suite, and retain prior report hashes.

case_groups.purpose: Reject malformed or mismatched protocol frames without exposing raw data.
case_groups.method: Literal mutations for duplicate/extra keys, duplicate request identity, bad UTF-8/JSON/base64/hash/protocol/newline/bound identity; fixed recognized and unrecognized child error frames.
case_groups.pass_criteria: Only the exact valid frame returns a DTO; malformed output is BRIDGE_PROTOCOL; recognized child codes are allowlisted; unknown child/spawn errors are fixed and sanitized.
case_groups.expected_result: Invalid frames cannot be reinterpreted as another profile or leak child diagnostics.
case_groups.failure_recovery: Retain the failing fixture and its output hash; do not broaden accepted frame shapes to match implementation output.

case_groups.purpose: Verify inclusive byte/deadline/concurrency limits and identity-safe behavior.
case_groups.method: Exact and plus-one byte limits; actual 2 MiB B01 snapshot; astral ensure_ascii expansion; invalid platform/config; timeout, cancellation during delayed spawn, repeated cancellation, real burst child overflow and PID reaping; 4 active plus 16 queued capacity.
case_groups.pass_criteria: Inclusive limits succeed, over-limit inputs fail with fixed codes before unsafe processing, active/queue limits are honored, and every launched process is closed/killed/reaped within bounded tests.
case_groups.expected_result: Resource controls enforce configured bounds without deadlocked pipes or orphaned children.
case_groups.failure_recovery: Preserve the bounded process/lifecycle evidence; repair cleanup or byte accounting and rerun the full targeted suite before freezing.

case_groups.purpose: Check configuration-completeness projection while preserving the underlying B01 record.
target: six B01 sections and nested arrays
case_groups.method: Fixed records with all four unresolved markers spread over all six required sections, empty nested path/case arrays, and a complete baseline.
case_groups.pass_criteria: Markers or empty required arrays make the projection incomplete; complete baseline remains complete; profile mode/enabled and raw data are retained.
case_groups.expected_result: Completeness is a deterministic projection and does not mutate B01 bytes.
case_groups.failure_recovery: Keep the fixed profile fixtures and correct only projection behavior or test fixture construction with a documented reason.

case_groups.purpose: Validate immutable catalog ingestion and the operator-only bridge invocation path.
case_groups.method: Operator CLI first import/idempotent replay and exact input ceiling; fixed malformed/missing config/extra args/duplicate or extra request keys/oversize input; DSN canary absence; direct conflict/active transaction/concurrent importer/runtime denial/surrogate BYTEA persistence.
case_groups.pass_criteria: A valid trusted bridge result is inserted once and exact retries return imported=false; conflicts and active transactions do not replace data; runtime role cannot import; output contains only fixed IDs/hashes/status and no DSN/profile bytes; no eligibility rows are created.
case_groups.expected_result: Catalog write authority remains separated from ordinary runtime access, and CLI errors/output do not disclose request or connection details.
case_groups.failure_recovery: Preserve sanitized test results and private cluster lifecycle separately; fix database transaction/privilege behavior or CLI validation without adding a real eligibility grant.

attempts.summary: 22 setup errors before product assertions; seed test helper passed fd 0 to fs/promises.readFile.
attempts.recovery: Seed helper now consumes process.stdin as an async iterable; no product behavior was changed for this failure.

attempts.summary: 19 passed, 3 failed: astral raw-byte expectation used escaped JSON; fake child exited zero in error-mapping test; numeric CLI profile version returned BRIDGE_INVALID_REQUEST before request-type validation was added.
attempts.recovery: TC now expects literal UTF-8 astral bytes and uses a nonzero fake exit for error translation; CLI validates string types before calling the bridge.

attempts.summary: 40 passed, 1 failed: test request fixture was one byte below STDIN_LIMIT because the placeholder byte was included in the baseline.
attempts.recovery: Corrected the independent exact-boundary input length by one byte; no acceptance limit was relaxed.

limitations: This is targeted G2 development evidence, not final B02 acceptance.
No actual external AT-21 identity/job/artifact/log/device endpoint scenarios were executed.
Catalog import is operator-path ingestion only; it does not grant profile eligibility or make an actual authority approval.
No full application acceptance, browser UI gate, or production Paperclip authentication claim is made.
